get.summary: Get effective public widget configuration for the request origin
get.description: Get effective public widget configuration for the request origin. This canonical NoxHere operation uses the authentication, project scope, and retry-safety metadata shown below.

post.description: Submit feedback from an origin-bound widget. Feedback cannot inspect a host website's login session: the host must explicitly pass its signed-in user through Feedback.identify(...) or Feedback.init({ getReporter }). reporterEmail is retained for resolution mail only when notifyOnResolution is true. An optional HTTPS reporterAvatarUrl is retained as private report metadata and is never copied into GitHub.

post.summary: Reopen a resolved report with optional reporter context
post.description: Consumes the single-use token from a Feedback resolution email, adds an optional response and screenshot to the original GitHub issue, and reopens the issue.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Opaque single-use reporter token from the resolution email.

screenshot.description: Optional PNG, JPEG, or WebP screenshot up to 7 MB.

400.description: The response or screenshot is invalid.

404.description: The response link is invalid, expired, or already used.

protectedServerActivity.summary: Server activity with an SDK-protected identity

post.description: Server applications authenticate with a project-scoped NoxHere API token carrying telemetry:ingest. Browser capture continues to use X-Nox-Ingest-Key with a publishable source key. Supply eventId or idempotencyKey when retrying error and feature events. User lifecycle facts are intrinsically deduplicated by source, user, type, and period.
Returns an opaque NoxHere device handle plus the GitHub verification URI and user code.
NoxHere completes the GitHub exchange server-side and returns its own short-lived access and rotating refresh credentials.
Rotates both native credentials. The previous access and refresh values stop working immediately.
Temporary one-time migration route for older Apple app releases. Normal sign-in uses the brokered device flow.
Send the rotating refresh credential so sign-out can revoke the server session even after the short-lived access credential expires. A valid access bearer remains supported for older clients.

browserSession.name: __Host-nox_session
browserSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly session created by an email magic link or GitHub OAuth. Browser mutations also require X-CSRF-Token.

noxApiToken.description: Organization- and project-bound, service-scoped NoxHere automation token. Store as a secret; the value is shown only once.

nativeSession.description: Short-lived first-party native application session issued by NoxHere. Refresh with a rotating nox_rt_ credential; provider credentials remain encrypted in NoxHere.

csrfProof.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfProof.description: Required with the nox_csrf cookie for unsafe browser-session requests. Native sessions and automation tokens do not use CSRF proof.

ifMatch.name: If-Match
ifMatch.description: ETag returned by the latest service config GET

projectContext.name: X-Project-ID
projectContext.description: Optional project selector inside the authenticated organization. Omit it for organization-wide data. When supplied, it must match any project identifier in the URL and the project bound to an API token.

telemetrySourceContext.name: X-Nox-Source-ID
telemetrySourceContext.description: Selects the destination source for a project-scoped NoxHere API token. It may be omitted when exactly one enabled source matches the token project and environment. Publishable source keys already identify their source.

team.description: Slack only: team (workspace) ID like T08B8C3E91N that pins Slack's authorize page to one workspace. An empty string or null leaves the workspace choice to Slack's picker. Omitted pins the organization's currently connected workspace so reconnects can't hop.

channelId.description: Optional candidate channel; otherwise uses saved routing and fallback.

reporterEmail.description: Reporter email supplied explicitly by the host or reporter. It is never inferred from the website session and is not copied into GitHub.

reporterAvatarUrl.description: Optional signed-in reporter profile picture supplied explicitly by the host. It is private report metadata and is never copied into GitHub.

notifyOnResolution.description: Explicit consent to retain the reporter email and send a transactional update when the report is resolved. Must not be true without reporter consent and requires reporterEmail.

screenshot.description: Bounded PNG, JPEG, or WebP data URL

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for completed daily periods.

items.description: Exact HTTPS origin; localhost HTTP is allowed for development.

productionStats.description: May only be true for a production source.

failureMessage.description: Default user-impact text shown with the actual bounded technical error.

enabled.description: Accept new events and include both derived outputs in reports.

owner.description: Defaults to the signed-in member and must match the signed-in member when provided.

stages.description: Ordered personal columns. Exactly one stage must set completed to true.

config.description: Shape depends on service. Feedback and Telemetry configuration is resource-scoped and linked from links.resources.

anyOf.description: Feedback and Telemetry have resource-scoped configuration; use links.resources.

displayName.description: Optional organization-facing name for this connection. Null restores the Slack workspace name.
